text: The game begins. Seven players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra, Opus. Nobody knows who the killers are.

Gemma, a killer, was voted out on Day 1 with six votes, and her last words pointed straight at Sol. On Day 2, Opus claimed to be the officer who had seen Gemma as a killer, but his card came up citizen and he admitted it was a bluff. Sonnet was killed on Night 2, and Haiku was killed on Night 3, after Haiku spent the days loudly defending Sol. On Day 3, the town voted out Luna, who had leaned on Opus's false story, with two votes to Sol's one. Sol and Terra were left alive, one killer and one other, so the killers won.
